name: Val-Du Lakes Campground
evidence: satellite (Esri, 700 m frame) at 43.6747,-86.4595: the site area is under canopy in the woods east of the N Wilson Rd junction, with farm fields north and a horse farm south; no lake or stream in frame (Silver Lake is several km west) - not waterfront. RV Life's pin (on the fields) and Google's (on the horse farm) both missed; pin set from the geocoded address into the woods

name: Best Bear Resort
